weapon.d:
Grants Atk+3. Enables【Canto (２)】during turns 1 through 4. At the start of turn 4, grants Special cooldown count-3 to unit. At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd+6 to unit during combat.
【Canto (２)】
After an attack, Assist skill, or structure destruction, unit can move ２ space(s).
(Unit moves according to movement type. Once per turn. Cannot attack or assist. Only highest value applied. Does not stack. After moving, if a skill that grants another action would be triggered (like with Galeforce), Canto will trigger after the granted action. Unit's base movement has no effect on movement granted. Cannot warp (using skills like Wings of Mercy) a distance greater than unit would be able to move with normal Canto movement.)

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Def.
Boosts damage by 80% of unit's Def.
At the start of turn 1, grants Special cooldown count-3 to unit. Boosts damage by 15 and calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res.

a.d: If unit initiates combat, grants Atk+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Spd+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk+6, Spd+7 during combat.

c.d: Grants Atk+2 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Atk+3 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Atk+4 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Atk+5 to allies in cardinal directions of unit during combat.
